title: wulfhilde material
description: A material of the wulfhilde engine, in a file ending .material.json: how a surface responds to light, with glTF's metallic-roughness properties, each a factor times an optional texture. A material is opaque and seen from the front only. The engine checks the same rules when it loads a material, and more that a schema can't state: a key written twice, a number too near zero to read, and whether each texture's image is there, is a PNG of at most 4,096 pixels on a side, and can be read as its property reads it.

$schema.description: The schema that an editor checks the file against. The engine ignores it.

format.description: What the file is: a wulfhilde material.

version.description: The version of the material format the file is written in. This version of the engine reads version 1 only.

color.description: The base colour: the colour of a dielectric, or the reflectance of a metal.

factor.description: What the texture is multiplied by, or the colour itself without one. Defaults to [1, 1, 1] with a texture.

texture.description: An image of the colour, in sRGB, which may not have an alpha channel, since a material is opaque.

roughness.description: The roughness, from 0 for a mirror to 1 for fully rough.

metallic.description: The metalness, from 0 for a dielectric to 1 for a metal.

normal.description: A normal texture, which tilts the surface's normal in tangent space. Without one, the surface is flat.

texture.description: An image of red, green and blue, as glTF and OpenGL have it: red is +u, green is +v, and blue points out of the surface.

scale.description: What the texture's u and v components are multiplied by. Defaults to 1.

occlusion.description: The ambient occlusion, from 0, where no ambient light reaches, to 1, where it all does. Without it, there is none.

strength.description: How strongly the occlusion applies, from 0 for not at all to 1 for fully. Defaults to 1.

emission.description: The light the material gives out of itself, which lights nothing else: nits times the colour times the texture. Without it, there is none.

nits.description: The luminance of white, in nits.

temperature.description: The colour of the light as a black body's temperature, in kelvin, at the luminance of white.

texture.description: An image of the light's colour, in sRGB.

size.description: The real-world size, in metres along u and v, of one repeat of the material's textures, which all share it. The bottom-left corner of each texture lies at the origin of u and v. A material has it exactly when it has a texture.

properties.description: Game-defined data, which the engine keeps and ignores.

number.description: A number within the range the engine reads numbers in, that of a single-precision float.

length.description: A length, in metres, of more than 0.

color.description: A colour in linear Rec.709, [r, g, b], each component from 0 to 1.

texture.description: The asset path of an image, a PNG file ending .png under the content root, in /-separated segments of a-z, 0-9, _ and -, without the extension. Its colour space is the one its property reads it in, whatever the PNG says.

valueProperty.description: A property of one value: a factor times one channel of an optional texture. Where it is used, it says that no other member may sit beside its own.

factor.description: What the texture is multiplied by, or the value itself without one. Defaults to 1 with a texture.

texture.description: An image of the value, read linearly: a grey image, or an image of several channels of which `channel` names the one to read.

channel.description: The channel of the texture that holds the value, which an image of several channels needs.
